name: DVR2VOD
description: Publishes completed DVR recordings as a VOD-style M3U playlist so they play in TiviMate and other clients, grouped per show or as flat movies. Points at Dispatcharr's own recording file endpoint - no core modification, no files moved.
author: Rayplsrelax

fields.label: [LIBRARY]
fields.description: How completed recordings are presented in the generated playlist. Regenerated automatically when a recording finishes, and manually from the buttons below.

fields.label: Library layout
fields.help_text: series_per_show groups recordings by detected show name (each show becomes its own group-title, like season folders). flat_movies puts every recording in the single group below.

fields.label: [PLAYBACK URL]
fields.description: The playlist links to Dispatcharr's recording file endpoint, so entries need a base URL your client can reach, plus a token that endpoint accepts.

fields.label: Dispatcharr base URL
fields.help_text: Must be reachable from the DEVICE playing the video, not just from Dispatcharr itself - a LAN IP or hostname, never 'localhost'. Leave empty to derive from Django's allowed hosts at generate time (best effort).

fields.label: Access token for recording playback
fields.help_text: The recording file endpoint requires authentication: a JWT, an API key header, or a ?token= query parameter. Put the token value here; it is appended to every entry URL and is never written to the logs.

fields.label: [OUTPUT]
fields.description: Where the generated playlist file is written inside the Dispatcharr container.

fields.label: Playlist output path
fields.help_text: Empty (default) writes recordings.m3u into this plugin's own data folder, which survives plugin updates. Set an absolute path (e.g. /data/recordings.m3u) to write elsewhere, e.g. a mount your clients can fetch from.

fields.label: Regenerate automatically when a recording ends
fields.help_text: ON: every completed recording triggers a playlist rebuild in a background thread. The recording endpoint only needs the recording row, not the remuxed file, so the playlist may briefly include an entry a second before its file is final.

actions.label: Preview library (no file written)
actions.description: Shows how many completed recordings were found and the first entries exactly as they would appear in the playlist.

actions.label: Generate playlist
actions.description: Builds and writes recordings.m3u from all completed recordings.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Completed recording count, output path, and when the playlist was last generated.

actions.label: Handle recording_end
actions.description: Internal. Fires automatically when a recording finishes.
